_comentario: Planos independientes: ninguno depende de otro, así que todos paralelizan y cualquiera se rehace solo. Se montan con cortes. Cada plano lleva 'usa' con el tramo que va a la línea: se genera de más porque H3 no baja de 5,17 s.

planos.funcion: HOOK. Algo entra en una frecuencia que debería estar muerta.
planos.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic footage in a polar whiteout, vertical 9:16.
MOTION: The waveform in the reflection spikes hard, twice, then settles. The head turns very slightly toward it. Frost crystals shift on the strap.
AUDIO: [SFX] a burst of radio static, close and dry, then a carrier tone settling. [Ambient] a low room hum and the wind pressing on the walls outside.
NO SPEECH. No voices, no words, no dialogue, no singing, no crowd chatter. The only sounds are the wind, the radio static and the structure.
Keep the framing of the first frame. Grainy, cold, desaturated, photographic. Not animated, not illustrated, not CGI-looking.
